purpose: Machine-readable boundaries for adapter proof, renderer expansion, and COURT contract ownership.

authority.adapter_proof: deterministic evidence that RACKET can consume a named COURT or product fixture snapshot
authority.product_readiness: product repository decision over rules, assets, scene direction, runtime policy, and user-facing tests
authority.renderer_gate: explicit named product fixture need plus role review and VTRACE work package
authority.court_contract_truth: COURT reviewed snapshot, scene, action, and compatibility policy fields
authority.racket_contract_scope: adapter mapping, diagnostics, windowless runtime reports, and RUNE descriptor evidence

pitfall_boundaries.sourceLayer: frame-plan reports, runtime reports, proof-surface fixtures, AMAZE/TIGRIS fixtures, README status, release notes, and portfolio dependency updates
maySupport: adapter compatibility for a named fixture
requiredEvidence: retained ready and not-ready adapter reports

pitfall_boundaries.sourceLayer: PRODUCT_PLAN, VTRACE work packages, runtime waves, demos, backend-selection notes, and product fixture requests
blockedClaims: renderer work is next by default
input pipeline commitment without fixture need
asset pipeline commitment without fixture need

pitfall_boundaries.sourceLayer: COURT snapshot mapping, RUNE descriptors, public Rust API, fixture migrations, VTRACE interfaces, and compatibility policy
blockedClaims: compatibility shim as source of truth
descriptor field that changes COURT semantics
